payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the same woman’s jacket in the source and edited images, is its front closure fully closed, partly closed with visible progress, unchanged, or indeterminate?
node.criteria: complete: the jacket’s front closure is visibly fully closed in the edited image. partial: the front is not fully closed, but visible changes in overlap or closure show progress toward closing compared with the source. absent: there is no visible progress toward closing compared with the source; do not count a change in pose or the jacket swinging outward as closure progress. unknown: the front closure is occluded or the images otherwise provide insufficient evidence to determine closure or progress.
node.binding: Compare the same woman’s jacket front and closure in the source and edited images. Assess visible overlap/closure changes, not pose or fabric swing.

outcome.description: The woman’s jacket is closed fully.
outcome.reference: Make her close her jacket fully
